I started learning qdrant database using vector-4 then i used vector side 1536 in actual application. upsert operation performed via springboot application.

//Lists all collections available in Qdrant.
GET collections

//Creates the candidate_profiles collection with 1536-dimensional vectors and Cosine distance for semantic similarity search.
PUT /collections/candidate_profiles
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "vectors": {
    "size": 1536,
    "distance": "Cosine"
  }
}

//Returns configuration and status details of the candidate_profiles collection
GET collections/candidate_profiles

//Retrieves stored points from the collection without performing a similarity search.
POST /collections/candidate_profiles/points/scroll

//Returns the exact number of points stored in the collection.
POST /collections/candidate_profiles/points/count?exact=true

//Performs semantic vector search and returns the Top-K most similar candidate profiles
POST /collections/candidate_profiles/points/query
{
  "query": [/* paste the 1536-dimensional embedding here */],
  "limit": 5,
  "with_payload": true
}

//Filters results using AND logic, where all specified conditions must match.
POST /collections/candidate_profiles/points/query
{
  "query": [/* paste the 1536-dimensional embedding here */],
  "limit": 5,
  "with_payload": true,
  "filter": {
    "must": [
      {
        "key": "country",
        "match": {
          "value": "India"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}

//Combines required conditions with exclusions to narrow the search results.
POST /collections/candidate_profiles/points/query
{
  "query": [/* paste the 1536-dimensional embedding here */],
  "limit": 5,
  "with_payload": true,
  "filter": {
    "must": [
      {
        "key": "country",
        "match": {
          "value": "India"
        }
      }
    ],
    "must_not": [
      {
        "key": "location",
        "match": {
          "value": "Bengaluru"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}

//Filters results using OR logic, where matching any of the specified conditions is sufficient.
I have not put query vector in below query, I want only filter, if you want you can apply 
POST /collections/candidate_profiles/points/query
{
  "limit": 5,
  "with_payload": true,
  "filter": {
    "should": [
      {
        "key": "profileType",
        "match": {
          "value": "TECH"
        }
      },
      {
        "key": "country",
        "match": {
          "value": "USA"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}

Combines mandatory conditions with additional OR-based conditions to refine the search.
POST /collections/candidate_profiles/points/query
{
  "limit": 5,
  "with_payload": true,
  "filter": {
    "must": [
      {
        "key": "profileType",
        "match": {
          "value": "TECH"
        }
      }
    ],
    "should": [
      {
        "key": "country",
        "match": {
          "value": "Germany"
        }
      },
      {
        "key": "country",
        "match": {
          "value": "USA"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
